inline_prompts: We have a directed graph with N vertices, numbered 1, 2, \ldots, N. Information about the edges is given by N^2 characters C_{1, 1}, C_{1, 2}, \ldots, C_{1, N}, C_{2, 1}, \ldots, C_{N, N}. Here, each C_{i, j} is either a lowercase English letter or -. If C_{i, j} is a lowercase English letter, then there is exactly one directed edge from vertex i to vertex j labeled C_{i, j}. For each integer pair (i, j) with 1 \leq i, j \leq N, answer the following question: Among all paths from vertex i to vertex j whose concatenation of labels on the edges forms a palindrome, what is the length of the shortest such path?
